_comment: Maps a unit name key to the art that draws it. A key can be: an exact tiered name ('Medium Tank III'), an era range ('Infantry 1900-1925'), or a bare family name used as the catch-all for every tier/year that has no more specific entry ('Infantry', 'Artillery'). Anything not covered here falls back to the classic art.
_comment_variants: A key's value is either one entry or a list of them. Each entry is either a plain filename (applies to whichever country asks) or an object {'file': ..., 'countries': [...]} restricted to those country ids -- the exact strings that key data/json/countries_data.json, e.g. 'Germany', 'German Reich', 'German Empire'. A country matching one of the restricted entries sees that picture; everyone else falls through to the first unrestricted entry for that key, and if there isn't one, to the next fallback rule (e.g. 'Infantry 1900-1925' missing a generic falls back to the bare 'Infantry' entry below) and eventually to classic. See map_logic/rendering/symbol_loader.py for the exact matching and fallback rules.
